name: whatsapp-gpt
description: WhatsApp GPT - a ChatGPT/Cursor-style agent over your WhatsApp chats, 100% local data

scripts.dist:mac-arm64: bash scripts/generate-icon-icns.sh && bash scripts/prepare-node.sh darwin-arm64 && bash scripts/rebuild-sqlite-for-node.sh build/node/bin/node && electron-builder --mac --arm64 && npm_config_python=/usr/bin/python3 PYTHON=/usr/bin/python3 npm rebuild better-sqlite3
scripts.dist:mac-x64: bash scripts/generate-icon-icns.sh && bash scripts/prepare-node.sh darwin-x64 && bash scripts/rebuild-sqlite-for-node.sh build/node/bin/node && electron-builder --mac --x64 && npm_config_python=/usr/bin/python3 PYTHON=/usr/bin/python3 npm rebuild better-sqlite3
scripts.dist:mac: npm run dist:mac-arm64 && npm run dist:mac-x64
scripts.dist:win: bash scripts/prepare-node.sh win-x64 && bash scripts/rebuild-sqlite-for-node.sh build/node/bin/node.exe && electron-builder --win --x64 && npm rebuild better-sqlite3
scripts.dist:linux: bash scripts/prepare-node.sh linux-x64 && bash scripts/rebuild-sqlite-for-node.sh build/node/bin/node && electron-builder --linux --x64 && npm rebuild better-sqlite3

extendInfo.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Searchable keeps your chats on this Mac. It only opens a local loopback server (127.0.0.1) for the app window — it does not share data on your LAN.
